## Checklist

- [ ] No game data in the commit (ISO, extracted files, textures, models, audio, decompiler output)
- [ ] It has a menu switch (or a `JAK_ENHANCED_*` variable) so it can be turned off and compared
- [ ] Documented in ENHANCED.md (a row in the table or a paragraph: how it works, its switches)
- [ ] Tried in the game: where, at what time of day, what population
- [ ] AI assistance, if any, is said here (which tool, how much), and I understand the change
